metadata.description: Primary-source catalog for retrieval engineering: retrieval mode choice, hosted retrieval, tool-first/MCP, crawl and research ingestion, hybrid and multivector search, multimodal and graph retrieval, evaluation, observability, and 2025-2026 research additions (hallucination detection, corpus poisoning, LazyGraphRAG, LightRAG, Jina reranker-v3, iterative retrieval, long-context degradation, agentic RAG query planning, SDAG sparse-attention poisoning defense, ColBERT-Att, AMES, OpenAI Responses API file search, streaming trust-weight EMA for graph-element confidence).
metadata.title: AI RAG - Sources

foundational_research.name: The Semantic Illusion: Certified Limits of Embedding-Based Hallucination Detection in RAG Systems
foundational_research.relevance: Single-author preprint (grade C). Embedding/NLI hallucination detectors yield ~100% FPR at high recall on real RLHF-model hallucinations (HaluEval); GPT-4-as-judge ≈7% FPR. Use LLM reasoning judge for production safety gates.

foundational_research.name: A-RAG: Scaling Agentic RAG via Hierarchical Retrieval Interfaces
foundational_research.relevance: Preprint (grade C, verified May 2026). Proposes hierarchical retrieval tools (keyword search, semantic search, chunk reading) so the agent adaptively selects retrieval granularity per sub-question. Reports OOD QA benchmark gains with comparable or fewer retrieved tokens vs fixed-pipeline RAG. Supports query-planning-first and multi-granularity retrieval patterns.

foundational_research.name: SDAG: Sparse Document Attention for Corpus Poisoning Defense
foundational_research.relevance: Preprint (grade C, verified May 2026). Block-sparse attention prevents cross-document adversarial influence at generation time. No fine-tuning required. Complements hybrid retrieval (retrieval-time defense) with a generation-time defense layer. Test against your own poisoning corpus before relying on in production.

foundational_research.name: Iterative Retrieval for Multi-Hop QA (ChemKGMultiHopQA)
foundational_research.relevance: Preprint (grade B, chemistry domain). Iterative retrieve-refine beats all-gold-context by up to +25.6pp (non-reasoning) / ~+9.7pp (reasoning) on multi-hop questions. Supports using agentic loops for multi-hop, not simple lookup.

foundational_research.name: Long-Context Retrieval Degradation with Hard Negatives (replication)
foundational_research.relevance: Preprint replication of SIGIR 2025 / ICLR 2025 finding (grade B). Increasing retrieved top-k degrades quality when hard negatives are present; rerank before context packing.

foundational_research.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
foundational_research.relevance: Foundational framing for separating retrieval and generation responsibilities.

foundational_research.name: BEIR Benchmark
foundational_research.relevance: Durable benchmark reference for retrieval quality across heterogeneous datasets.

foundational_research.name: HyDE: Hypothetical Document Embeddings
foundational_research.relevance: Useful for query-side retrieval improvement when user queries are underspecified.

foundational_research.name: Seven Failure Points in RAG Systems
foundational_research.relevance: Failure taxonomy for chunking, retrieval, ranking, synthesis, and citations.

foundational_research.name: Self-RAG
foundational_research.relevance: Reference for adaptive retrieval and self-correction patterns.

foundational_research.name: ColBERT
foundational_research.relevance: Foundational late-interaction retrieval reference for multivector-style precision upgrades.

hosted_retrieval_and_protocols.name: Anthropic Web Search Tool Reference
hosted_retrieval_and_protocols.relevance: Primary source for Anthropic managed web retrieval. Current versions: web_search_20260209 (dynamic filtering, recommended) and web_search_20250305 (basic). Supports allowed_domains, blocked_domains, max_uses, user_location. $10/1k searches. Not available on Bedrock; Vertex AI basic only.

hosted_retrieval_and_protocols.name: OpenAI File Search Guide (Responses API)
hosted_retrieval_and_protocols.relevance: Primary source for provider-managed hosted retrieval via the Responses API + Vector Store API. The Assistants API file-search is deprecated April 2026, shutdown August 26 2026 — new work must use the Responses API.

hosted_retrieval_and_protocols.name: Model Context Protocol Introduction
hosted_retrieval_and_protocols.relevance: Primary source for tool-first and resource-based retrieval over MCP.

hosted_retrieval_and_protocols.name: Anthropic Contextual Retrieval
hosted_retrieval_and_protocols.relevance: Primary source for chunk-context augmentation as an alternative to full late chunking.

vector_and_search_platforms.name: Jina reranker-v3
vector_and_search_platforms.relevance: Preprint (arXiv 2509.25085, verified July 2026) + HF corroboration (grade B). ~0.6B params (built on Qwen3-0.6B), listwise causal ('last but not late interaction') architecture, up to 64-doc window within 131K token context. BEIR 61.94 nDCG@10 (SOTA among evaluated rerankers at publication), MIRACL 66.50 (18 langs); beats bge-reranker-v2-m3 (same param count) and mxbai-rerank-large-v2 (2.5x larger) on BEIR. License CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial) — Jina AI is now part of Elastic; commercial use requires an Elastic sales license waiver, and roadmap/support continuity should be confirmed post-acquisition before depending on this model. Verify current standing on MTEB/Agentset leaderboard before citing as SOTA.

vector_and_search_platforms.name: Zerank-2
vector_and_search_platforms.relevance: Top-ranked open-weight reranker on Agentset Reranker Leaderboard (Feb 2026). Verify current standing before citing as SOTA.

vector_and_search_platforms.name: Cohere Rerank 4 Pro
vector_and_search_platforms.relevance: Top-ranked commercial reranker on Agentset Reranker Leaderboard (Feb 2026). Verify current standing and pricing before citing as SOTA.

vector_and_search_platforms.name: Voyage rerank-2.5
vector_and_search_platforms.relevance: Top-ranked commercial reranker on Agentset Reranker Leaderboard (Feb 2026). Verify current standing and pricing before citing as SOTA.

vector_and_search_platforms.name: Voyage 4 Large
vector_and_search_platforms.relevance: MoE embedding model from Voyage AI. Verify current MTEB standing and pricing before citing as SOTA.

vector_and_search_platforms.name: Long-Context Retrieval Degradation — SIGIR 2025
vector_and_search_platforms.relevance: Peer-reviewed (grade B, SIGIR 2025 + ICLR 2025 + replication arXiv 2501.01880). Retrieved top-k quality rises then degrades when hard negatives are present. Rerank before context packing.

multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.name: Microsoft GraphRAG
multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.relevance: Primary source for graph-based retrieval and community summary patterns.

multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.name: Microsoft BenchmarkQED — LazyGraphRAG Evaluation
multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.relevance: Corporate study (grade B, MIT license, multi-baseline). LazyGraphRAG achieves ~700× lower query cost than full GraphRAG Global at comparable global-query quality. Recommended default starting point for graph-augmented retrieval.

multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.name: LightRAG
multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.relevance: Framework-agnostic dual-level graph + vector RAG (MIT). Cost-dominant alternative to Microsoft GraphRAG for teams not on the MS stack. Published benchmarks: ~$0.50 / ~3 min to index 500 pages; ~70-90% of full GraphRAG quality across domains. Verify on your own corpus before citing numbers.

multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.name: ColPali
multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.relevance: Primary source for visual-document retrieval over PDFs and page images.

multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.name: ColBERT-Att (arXiv 2603.25248)
multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.relevance: ECIR 2026 LIR workshop. Late interaction + attention weights on query and document terms; recall gains on MS-MARCO, BEIR, and LoTTE. Relevant for PDF page retrieval where standard ColBERT precision is insufficient.

multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.name: AMES — Approximate Multimodal Enterprise Search (arXiv 2603.13537)
multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.relevance: ECIR 2026 LIR workshop. Late interaction for cross-modal retrieval (text + image + table) without modality-specific logic; two-stage pipeline; ViDoRe V3 benchmark. Relevant for mixed-modality PDF corpora.

multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.name: Unstructured Documentation
multimodal_and_graph_retrieval.relevance: Primary source for parsing mixed documents, PDFs, tables, and images before retrieval.

aws_native_rag.name: Amazon Bedrock Embeddings — Amazon Nova 2 Multimodal
aws_native_rag.relevance: AWS-native default embedder for Bedrock Knowledge Bases as of 2026; supersedes Titan Embeddings for new KB builds. Verify current Bedrock embeddings catalog before selecting.

aws_native_rag.name: Amazon Textract
aws_native_rag.relevance: AWS-native OCR and document extraction service. Returns form key-value pairs, table cells, and multi-page structure beyond generic PDF text extraction. AWS-native preprocessing step before Bedrock KB ingestion for scanned or form-heavy documents.

aws_native_rag.name: paperless-ngx REST API
aws_native_rag.relevance: Self-hosted document archive (scanned PDFs, invoices, contracts). REST API at /api/documents/ and consume folder ingestion. Documents exit pre-OCR'd with metadata, usable as a corpus source for Bedrock KB or custom RAG pipelines.

aws_native_rag.name: Amazon Bedrock Data Automation (BDA)
aws_native_rag.relevance: AWS-recommended intelligent document processing front door for Bedrock RAG pipelines (March 2026 unification). One API classifies and extracts via foundation models, flat per-doc pricing. Uses Textract as OCR layer for complex docs in 'Bedrock Pipeline' mode; standalone Textract remains best for high-volume standardized formats (~75% cheaper per doc, ~95%+ compliance accuracy).

aws_native_rag.name: Amazon Bedrock Rerank API
aws_native_rag.relevance: Managed reranking wired directly into Bedrock KB retrieval (June 2026). Available models: Cohere Rerank 3.5 and Amazon Rerank. Removes the need for a separate reranker call after Retrieve. Cohere Command R/R+ are now legacy; active Cohere surface in Bedrock = Embed v3/v4 + Rerank 3.5.

aws_native_rag.name: Amazon Kendra GenAI Index
aws_native_rag.relevance: Managed retriever (hybrid keyword+vector + semantic + built-in reranker). Index once, reuse across Bedrock Knowledge Bases AND Amazon Q Business. Bedrock KB can be built on top of it. AWS production enterprise-RAG stack: Kendra GenAI Index + Retriever API + Bedrock FM.

aws_native_rag.name: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails
aws_native_rag.relevance: AWS-native safety/governance layer for RAG. Contextual grounding check (grounding + relevance thresholds) is the managed hallucination/faithfulness gate; plus PII redaction, denied topics, prompt-attack detection, Automated Reasoning. Integrates with RetrieveAndGenerate and the standalone ApplyGuardrail API.

research_and_ingestion_tooling.relevance: Reference for website crawling, extraction, and Markdown-first ingestion before retrieval.

evaluation_frameworks.name: CCRS — Calibrated Confidence for RAG Systems (arXiv 2506.20128)
evaluation_frameworks.relevance: Zero-shot LLM-as-judge RAG evaluation framework; no labeled data required. Cited in rag-evaluation-guide.md tooling section. Verify against your own corpus before production use.

security_and_observability.name: PoisonedRAG — Corpus Poisoning Attack and Defense
security_and_observability.relevance: USENIX Security 2025 (peer-reviewed). ~5 injected adversarial docs → >90% ASR on vector-only RAG. BM25+vector hybrid (RRF, α≈0.3–0.7) drops gradient-guided adversarial co-retrieval from 38%→0%. Hybrid retrieval is an architectural poisoning defense.

security_and_observability.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
security_and_observability.relevance: Threat model for prompt injection, data leakage, and insecure retrieval pipelines.

security_and_observability.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions
security_and_observability.relevance: Primary source for tracing model and retrieval events while noting the conventions continue to evolve.

operational_brain_references.name: garrytan/gbrain
operational_brain_references.relevance: MIT-licensed operational agent-brain reference for routing relationship questions to typed graph traversal while using hybrid lexical + vector search for evidence text and citations.

operational_brain_references.name: topoteretes/cognee
operational_brain_references.relevance: Apache-2.0 agent-memory/graph-RAG framework. Source for P-CS-5 in confidence-scoring.md: streaming per-element (node/edge) trust-weight update via exponential moving average (`stream_update_weight`, default alpha=0.1) applied at each feedback event with O(1) cost and no retrain pass, consumed downstream in retrieval scoring (brute_force_triplet_search.py). alpha=0.1 is cognee's own calibration, not a universal constant.
